ex.s: It does point out that many parents still limit electronic reading, mainly due to concerns about increased screen time.

ex.s: So even if emissions were to begin to decrease today, we would still face the challenge of adapting to climate change.

ex.t: 我依然热爱夜晚，会无缘无故熬到离谱的时间，上网聊天、看视频。

ex.s: Now we live in a world surrounded by the "can't do" attitudes． We all fall down． We all have doubts and regrets． Still we must climb and dream about what's at the top of our mountain． Monsters may appear or the night will fall． But never ever give up on your dream!
